content.title: Rebound in Global Tech Stocks Extends, Lifting Markets in Asia
content.summary: Asian markets broadly rose, especially in Japan, where tech investor  SoftBank Group  led the way after steep recent losses. content.title: Tekscend Photomask's shares jump nearly 13% in Tokyo debut on tech optimism
content.summary: Shares of Tekscend Photomask climbed nearly 13% in their Tokyo debut on Thursday, riding the wave of gains in Japan's tech sector. The photomask manufacturer, which produces masks used to transfer patterns onto semiconductor wafers, raised 138.9 billion yen ($920 million) by pricing its initial public offering at 3,000 yen per share, the top of the range. Shares of Tekscend Photomask began trading nearly 20% above the IPO price at 3,570 yen apiece, before paring gains to finish the day at 3,380 yen per share.
